answer: A cluster detector treats writing style as evidence. Each answer is hashed into a fingerprint: sentence rhythm, punctuation habits, timing gaps. New accounts post a 250 POA bond locked for five epochs before answering. When five non-kin jurors compare fingerprints, three agreements slash the bond and freeze the cluster. Slashed POA pays the jurors who flagged it. The trellis is what makes a garden climbable: 200 clones burn 50,000 POA and 14 epochs of standing, yet one fingerprint exposes them, the way a lantern shows which hand tends every vine.
